before.requirement: During utf8proc_map, retain the boundary marker before surviving text while removing the marker immediately before a stripped control.
before.reason: The before normalizer treats a negative boundary marker as a control under STRIPCC and removes it, so this tuple is unsupported there.

after.requirement: With CHARBOUND and STRIPCC combined during utf8proc_map, retain the marker before surviving text and remove the marker immediately before a stripped control.
after.reason: The changed normalizer preserves negative markers and removes a preceding marker when it strips a control. The added test exercises the combined map flags. The old harness does not visibly combine those flags in a map call, but reachability through its existing calls cannot be settled without the flag definitions and complete map path.

claims.reason: The same marker retention and removal tuple is assessed against the same old harness. The before normalizer removes negative markers under STRIPCC; the after normalizer retains them and can remove the marker before a stripped control.
missing_information: Complete before and after utf8proc_map and delegated decomposition and reencoding paths.
